title: 📊 Daily Report: Wed Nov 11, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $17,858.42. For the week it's up $39.51 against Monday's base: the strategies are up $39.51 and CORE QQQ is unchanged. Since the merge the book is down 10.80% ($2,162.32), while Indy (the SPY buy-and-hold benchmark) is down 2.41% ($482.46), so we're trailing by $1,679.86.

Rota traded today, selling VEEV for a $5.87 loss after its rotation rank slipped. No new positions were opened. Four positions remain open (Trek in ACN and VRSN, Sunny in MPC and PSX). Sunny is the only active bot; Trek and Rota have no edge, and the rest are benched. CORE QQQ is off (in cash) with the trend filter out — prior close 674.76 vs the 200-day at 680.34. Idle cash earned $1.79 in interest today.

Research's analyst note for today:
- AI relief rally: CoreWeave's beat and its pledge to skip unsecured debt sent CRWV up 24.7% and lifted chips (MU +11.9%, AVGO +4%). The S&P rose 1.3% and the Nasdaq 1.6%, leaving the S&P about 2.6% below its record.
- NVDA rose 2.9% despite a Baird downgrade over the CEO probe. We kept the whole AI-hardware group on avoid through Friday, because last week's first bounce after the shock faded.
- Costco rose about 2% on a $30 special dividend plus a $4B buyback. That fits our winning pattern (non-tech capital returns), so we're logging it as a small swing idea and exiting before the 11/24 record date.
- Up next: NBIS reports before the open Thursday, AMAT and CSCO after the close, then jobless claims Thursday and October PPI Friday. With rates near 5%, a hot PPI could reverse today's bounce.

Floor: https://blackk92.github.io/tendies-and-dip/

Claude impact: no advice batches yet.
